svg.title: Housing knowledge-base RAG assistant — in use; hybrid BM25 + dense retrieval with reranking, 37-query retrieval regression (Hit@5 1.00, MRR@10 0.89), RAGAS release gate. These scores describe the fixed regression set; broader retrieval quality and operating scale require separate evidence.
